algorithm.Title: Hand Swelling - Male (Adult)
algorithm.ContentSet: IST Open-Source Guideline Content | Adult | Male
Definition: UAT-only adult and pediatric hand-swelling pathway screening for infection, allergy, vascular obstruction, constriction and occult trauma before in-person assessment.
FirstAid: Call Qatar emergency services on 999 for an ambulance for rapidly spreading swelling/infection with systemic illness, severe pain, or a cold/pale/blue/numb hand; do not self-drive. Remove rings if easy; do not squeeze or drain. Call Qatar 999 now, follow the call-taker's ambulance and emergency-transport instructions, and do not self-drive. Do not delay emergency care.

questions.Question: Did this problem begin with a motor vehicle crash or as part of a multi-system crash injury?
questions.Information: A motor vehicle crash or multi-system crash injury belongs in the Motor Vehicle Accident pathway.

questions.Question: Is hand swelling severe with a cold/pale/blue/numb hand or constricting ring, or is there rapidly spreading redness/swelling plus marked systemic illness or deterioration?
questions.Information: Inability to stand or bear weight, or marked systemic deterioration including in a child, requires emergency assessment through the Qatar pathway.

questions.Question: With no emergency feature, is there any persistent or unexplained hand swelling, asymmetry, redness/heat, wound, child concern or higher-risk context?
questions.Information: In-person assessment is required to exclude infection, allergy, vascular/lymphatic obstruction, inflammatory disease and occult trauma.

advice.Title: Qatar emergency hand-swelling response
Content: Call Qatar emergency services on 999 for an ambulance for rapidly spreading swelling/infection with systemic illness, severe pain, or a cold/pale/blue/numb hand; do not self-drive. Remove rings if easy; do not squeeze or drain. Call Qatar 999 now, follow the call-taker's ambulance and emergency-transport instructions, and do not self-drive. Do not delay emergency care.
Call Back If: fever worsens; redness spreads; colour or sensation changes.

advice.Title: In-person hand-swelling assessment
Content: Arrange in-person assessment; unexplained swelling may reflect infection, inflammatory disease, allergy, vascular obstruction or occult injury. Medication and exact Qatar destination are local approval required.
Call Back If: redness, warmth or fever; swelling progresses.
